pattern: SELECT .* FROM CONTESTANTS AS C LEFT JOIN VOTES AS V ON C\.contestant\_number = V\.contestant\_number GROUP BY C\.contestant\_number ORDER BY COUNT\(V\.vote\_id\) ASC LIMIT 1
correction: Replace the aggregation function with count(*), and ensure it counts unique contestants instead of vote_ids.

metadata.description: This rule corrects queries that incorrectly count vote_ids rather than the actual votes for each contestant.
